name: Delicious★Kiss ~Risou no Koibito~
original_name: デリシャス★キス～理想の恋人～
source:
A forceful kiss, a kiss of seduction, a clumsy kiss...
You've never shared any of those "adult" kisses with anyone.

Love is in the air between you and the men who, like you, happen to be on this luxury liner.
"Who is he? I can't believe he offered for me to stay in his room..."
The ending will surprise you...! A mature relationship with a thrilling climax is about to begin...

[Translated from [url=http://www.andamul.com/special/delikiss.html]official website[/url]]
